regimeSub: Q3 GDP 3.4% beat + Sep PCE reacceleration meets AI selloff driving Treasury haven bid, Lagarde exits ECB.
themes: Q3 GDP prints 3.4% QoQ vs estimates ~2.8% per CNBC/PBS, driven by consumer + AI capex → hot growth + sticky 4% CPI = stagflation persists; Fed Warsh holds 4% but hawkish dissent keeps Dec hike live
10Y yield drops to 5.05% from 4.99% on AI tech selloff driving flight-to-quality per Bloomberg/investingLive → 2s10s steepens to +38bp; real rate flat at 1.0% as inflation expectations anchor near 4%
ECB President Lagarde resigns per Guardian citing 'freedom of speech' → leadership vacuum adds EUR uncertainty; EURUSD holds 1.1193 as market awaits successor nomination
Brent crude eases to $112.13 as VP Vance restarts Iran peace talks per OilPrice → geopolitical premium softens; gold holds $4,000 on stagflation hedge despite oil dip

headline: Stagflation regime persists as Q3 GDP beats at 3.4% while Sep inflation reaccelerates, AI tech selloff sparks Treasury haven rally with 10Y at one-month lows, Lagarde resignation adds ECB uncertainty.
